patch.value: Drastically deepen pm-linear: (1) make --dry-run import/export build+print exact GraphQL request/variables and mutations with NO network call; (2) richer field mapping with generic --map linearField=pmField; (3) linear validate diagnostics command; (4) opt-in push-on-write hook mirroring pm writes to Linear (hooks capability); (5) fix unusable --no-preflight-network escape hatch on sync. All pure logic offline-testable. No live Linear creds available.
Deep enhancement: offline dry-run plans, --map field mapping, validate diagnostics, push-on-write hook

value.author: codex
value.text: DECISION (capabilities): registerExporter requires 'importers' (loader.js:1133), not a separate 'exporters' token. Existing manifest [commands,schema,importers,preflight] covers all current register* calls; no change needed for existing code. To add push-on-write we must add 'hooks' capability (api.hooks.onWrite => loader.js:1209) AND verify it activates.
